notes.title: ~New features, reworked flags, and more!~
notes.content: [h3]~Changes~ (1.3.0 – 1.3.9) [/h3][list][*][p]Green Flag behavior has changed: it now starts at x3 multiplier and decreases with each placed flag[/p][/*][*][p]Black Flag can no longer copy the same tile multiple times or copies of the same tile[/p][/*][*][p]Mine count now only shows non-debuffed mines instead of the total[/p][/*][*][p]Debuffed mines are automatically uncovered when shuffling the board with Jimmy, if they end up under a covered tile[/p][/*][*][p]Added loading screen tips![/p][/*][*][p]Boss and Final Boss boards now have different background patterns to distinguish them from regular boards[/p][/*][*][p]Shop prices now scale after each boss, instead of after every board[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New option settings:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Motion: Reduce/disable the movement of buttons and icons[/p][/*][*][p]Visual Aid: When enabled, selected tiles will glow[/p][/*][*][p]Timer: Active throughout the run (except loading screens); useful for Speedrunner/Fast Clicker achievements or speedruns in general[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]~Fixes~[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed grammatical errors[/p][/*][*][p]Black Flag no longer crashes the game when the board is full of tile effects[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted some item prices[/p][/*][*][p]Diamonds now display the score they provide[/p][/*][*][p]Many other small tweaks and fixes not listed here - There were many and i forgor[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ~Rebalancing + Demo Update~
notes.content:
[p]I figured a lot of changes were made, so the demo should be updated as well since it doesn't play the same anymore[/p][p][/p][h2]FULL GAME[/h2][h3]
CHANGES:[/h3][list][*][p] Green and interest tiles are now temporary.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p] The price of Interest and Green tiles don't scale with each board anymore.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p] Scoring has been adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p] Chording doesn't trigger mines when having a shield anymore.[/p][/*][*][p] Prices now scale with rank.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]DEMO[/h2][p]The demo has been updated and now has all the fixes and changes from the current version, differences:[/p][list][*][p]No achievements[/p][/*][*][p]Only first 2 Faces can be played (Jimmy/Joe)[/p][/*][*][p]Only first 2 flags can be used (Red/Blue)[/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3]

notes.title: ~Reworkin'~
notes.content:
[h1]Made various reworks to how the game is played[/h1]
Basically: tile permanence, reworked shops and prices, fixed some stuff, changed the way progression works

[b][h2]☻Changes☻[/h2][/b]
[b][h3]~Progression~[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] New progress bar in the shop to keep track of your run
[*] Boards are now choices

[list]
[*] In the shop, instead of seeing a set of 3 boards you have to beat, you can now choose between these boards. Pick whichever one you like the most!
[*] The only instance where you cannot choose your next board is the final boss.
[*] Some effects are easier to deal with than others, so those effects which are harder to deal with have lower completion percentage, and those which are easier needs you to make more progress on the board!
[*] Boards now display unique backgrounds when hovering the mouse over them.
[/list] [*] When completing a board, it no longer just says "Completed!" But displays the percentage of completion you have along with the multiplier it'll give you. For example: "100%! (x2)" 
[/list]
[b][h3]~Shop~[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Tiles are now permanent, but more expensive. If you didn't get to use your tile this board, you still have future chances to use it, it doesn't go to waste.
[*] Shop Layout has been reworked
[*] You can now hover on the tile icons to see their effect.
[*] Items or boards that add tiles will light up the tile they'll add, so you know what you're getting into
[*] Diamonds now give more score (equal to the price of 2 base rerolls)
[*] Since rerolling boards is no longer necessary, Alexandrite now gives you a shield
[list]

[*] The shield will spare you a mistake, avoiding death if a mine is triggered. They are stackable and last until you mess up.
[/list]
[/list] [b][h3]~Tiles~[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Crumbling Tiles take double the ammount of clicks to the board to trigger
[list]

[*] Now it takes 8 clicks to the board for it to break. More frames were added to breaking animation to reflect this
[/list][*] Erratic Tiles no longer trigger on clear, only when actively clicked.
[*] Jackie/Black Flag are now more expensive (15 Greens Each)
[/list]

[b][h2]☻Fixes☻[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Textboxes have been adjusted so they don't go offscreen in certain areas like they used to.
[*] Fixed a bug where uncovered crumbling tiles would still make a sound when their timer hit zero.
[*] Erratic Tiles no longer trigger with Jeanette's ability. They do, however, trigger with Johnny's ability which is kind of similar.
[*] Renamed some tiles and rewrote some descriptions for clarity and cohesion.
[*] Fixed a bug where the game wouldn't remember your selection properly, and would not set your last face and rank
[/list]

notes.title: --Dragging the camera, bugfixes and more!--
notes.content: [h1]I heard some people wanted to be able to [i][b]drag the board[/b][/i] to see better, so i did that![/h1][p][i][u]Also, got rid of more annoying bugs and changed some stuff for better communication[/u][/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]--CHANGES--[/b][/h3][list][*][p] You can drag the board by pressing middle click, to see better at higher zoom levels[/p][/*][*][p] Faces now wear sunglasses when you still have uses of your ability, and have a poker-face when you got no uses left, as an indicator.[/p][/*][*][p] Face description also changes when you can't currently use you ability[/p][/*][*][p] The game now remembers the last face, flag and rank you selected.[/p][/*][*][p] At the bottom of the shop, progression is now clearer so you know what challenge you're facing next[/p][/*][*][p] Jimmy's Description is now shorter to avoid confusion.[/p][/*][*][p] Social media has been moved to a corner instead of being with the rest of the menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added version number to the bottom of main menu to help with bug reports[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]--FIXES--[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Safe clicks don't get disabled when clicking a flagged tile. This also fixes the Regular Joe bug where it wouldn't let you use the ability right after.[/p][/*][*][p] Safe clicks don't get disabled with chording anymore.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a bug where blue flag wouldn't allow you to use your skill after use[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a bug where blue flag would kill you if you hit a mine on your first click, instead of relocating it.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: --Patchin' XS--
notes.content:
[h3][b]I've been reading some complaints about certain bugs today. And i hate bugs. So. Much[/b][/h3]
So yeah i did my best to fix 'em!

[h3][b]--CHANGES--[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Middle Click no longer ends the run.
[*] Instead, there's a pause menu you can access by pressing Escape.
[*] Twisted Jimmy and Blue Flag are now unlocked by default
[*] Lowered prices of unlocks!
[/list]

[h3][b]--FIXES--[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Cannot click buttons in the middle of a transition anymore.
[*] Fixed audio bug where a black tile would play a buzz in a loop when self destructed.
[*] Fixed bug where regular joe couldn't be triggered after black tile self destructed.
[*] 
[/list]

That's it for today. tysm for letting me know about these issues!
